استجرن (form X)
# اِسْتَجَرْنَ (istajarna) /is.ta.d͡ʒar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
# اُسْتُجِرْنَ (ustujirna) /us.tu.d͡ʒir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
# اِسْتَجِرْنَ (istajirna) /is.ta.d͡ʒir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجَارَ (istajāra)
